candidates.name: English Indices of Deprivation 2025 - Crime domain
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
limitations: The Crime domain is a relative risk/deprivation measure and cannot be used as an absolute parcel security percentage.
Use corrected v2 LSOA workbooks and corrected official lookup files.
Join by verified LSOA code and retain source rank/score semantics.

candidates.name: data.police.uk street-level crimes API and monthly archive
candidates.geography: anonymised street point, one-mile point query or custom polygon
limitations: Returned crime locations are approximate and anonymised.
One-mile point results are supporting area evidence, not exact parcel counts.
Use explicit month, rate-safe requests, HTTP status and SHA-256 response hash.
May 2026 changelog reports missing data for British Transport Police and Gloucestershire Constabulary.

candidates.name: Home Office police recorded crime and outcomes open data
candidates.geography: Police Force Area and Community Safety Partnership
limitations: Too coarse for direct parcel attribution.
Use for category validation, trend calibration and aggregate reconciliation only.

candidates.name: ONS Crime in England and Wales Police Force Area tables
candidates.geography: Police Force Area and Community Safety Partnership
limitations: Not suitable as a direct parcel score.
Use independently from Home Office source for aggregate reconciliation.

candidates.name: Official LSOA and Community Safety Partnership geography
limitations: Boundary and lookup vintage must match the statistical source vintage.
Geometry must be canonical and parcel centroid inclusion must be reproducible.

candidates.name: Fire and rescue incident statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
candidates.geography: England and fire and rescue service area
limitations: Too coarse for direct parcel attribution.
Do not combine with crime scoring without a separately validated composite model.
